 Versus

Appearance:
 Shri Aish Goyal - advocate for the applicant.

Ms. Shraddha Dixit -PL for the State.
 ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed u/S 438 of Cr.P.C./482 of BNSS seeking anticipatory bail by the applicant in connection with FIR/Crime No.31/2025 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station- Kotwali, District- Shajapur (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable u/S 376-D, 366,
323, 506, 328 and 343 of IPC.
2.
Prosecution story, in brief is that prosecutrix was already married with another person but due to some dispute, she used to reside at her parents house.
There was some illicit relationship between her first husband with other woman therefore, at the instance of her first husband, co-accused Kapil developed friendship with the prosecutrix.

On 11.01.2024, co-accused Kapil called the prosecutrix thereafter, she met him at his house and he took her to the house of Sanjay but he was not present at his house therefore, co-accused Kapil pressurized her and took her to Maksi.

Co-accused Kapil also forcibly solemnized marriage with her and made a video to show that prosecutrix had given her consent to NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6390 2 MCRC-9263-2025 solemnize the marriage.
Thereafter, applicant and co-accused Sanjay and Kapil took the prosecutrix to Ujjain and committed rape upon her.

sentences.text: Co-accused person Kapil also executed a compromise to show that prosecutrix is living with him in live-in-relationship.
He also demanded money from the prosecutrix and cash of Rs.15.00 lacs was given to the co-accused Kapil.
Thereafter, on 16.01.2024, co- accused Kapil left the prosecutrix at Shajapur.

The matter was reported on 13.01.2025.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that the matter was reported belatedly by around one year without any cogent explanation therefore, case of prosecution is doubtful.

It is also submitted that the prosecutrix used to reside with the co-accused Kapil in live-in-relationship and both the parties have executed an agreement on 11.01.2024 but due to some dispute, she lodged false report against the applicant and co-accused persons.
Applicant is a reputed person.
The police is trying to arrest him and if he gets arrested, his reputation will be tarnished.

Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be granted anticipatory bail.
4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State as well as counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.

5. Having considered the rival submissions and also considering material available in the case diary,
this Court is of the considered view that this is a fit case to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Hence, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant- HAJARI BANJARA @ HARJU @ HARJU NAYAK shall be released on bail upon furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6390 3 MCRC-9263-2025 surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before the Trial Court on all dates and for complying with the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of Cr.P.C./482 of BNSS.
7.

The applicant shall strictly abide the following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by police officer as and when required; and (ii) the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
8. The M.Cr.C. stands disposed of accordingly.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
